name: Ines
self_text: Hey there! I’m Ines, a mid‑30s Kenyan who loves to learn to sail—there’s nothing like watching the wind guide you. I mainly play Tidewatch on PC, usually jumping into casual matches to keep things light and fun. I’m a support player, so I love keeping the team together and helping teammates win. I chat either through text or voice, depending on the vibe. I’m not into coaching or giving lessons, but I’m happy to share tips if it helps. I’ve got free afternoons on Saturdays and Sundays, so let’s connect and sail—oops, I mean, play—some great games together!

requests.request_text: I need you are into Tidewatch. I need you play a damage role or you to be flexible about your role (a damage role | a flexible role (I can fill any position)). I need you are available any of Saturday afternoon or Sunday afternoon (Saturday afternoon | Sunday afternoon). I'd strongly prefer that you are into casual matches, though it's not a requirement.
